test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b9ababce6231fd3291e98d70de6e88c2f9f384e164de86f460db43f6e953e6f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 4 is common on both the dices figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 2, 5, 3, and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b14168adcf7ce81b7f33533627dcd816060937e89f978b8bdb78acf0cec54262.png] 

Opposite pairs:

2 → 6

5 → 3

4 → 1

So, the opposite side of "5" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
